title: Reject impossible event dates instead of silently moving them to another day
detail: The event input helpers accepted February 30, non-leap February 29, April 31 and 24:00 because Date normalized them into a different day. Validate wall-clock and date-only values by exact UTC round-trip before accepting them, and validate explicit-offset calendar parts before applying the offset. Preserve valid leap days, fractional seconds and colon/compact offsets. Five regression cases failed on the old source. Evidence is local helper behavior, not production event creation. No production data or schema changed. Final validation: 1,468 tests in 89 event/time/booking suites passed; the final focused helper and journey caller rerun passed 20 tests in two suites. Changed-file lint passed.

verify.note: Impossible dates and midnight rollover return null; valid leap dates and explicit-offset crossings retain their intended instant.
